property.name: yarn.scheduler.capacity.root.queues
property.description: Three top-level queues separating ETL, interactive analytics and batch.

property.name: yarn.scheduler.capacity.root.etl.capacity
property.description: 30% of cluster capacity reserved for ingestion (Flume/Sqoop).

property.name: yarn.scheduler.capacity.root.analytics.capacity
property.description: 40% reserved for interactive Spark/PySpark analytics and LDA training.

property.name: yarn.scheduler.capacity.root.batch.capacity
property.description: 30% reserved for long-running Hadoop MapReduce batch jobs.

property.name: yarn.scheduler.capacity.root.analytics.maximum-capacity
property.description: Analytics may burst to 70% when the batch queue is idle.

property.name: yarn.scheduler.capacity.root.default.maximum-applications
property.description: Cap concurrent applications to protect the ResourceManager.
